candidates.name: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease
support_spans: sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells
candidates.why: The presence of atypical mononuclear cells in the skin biopsy suggests a lymphoproliferative disorder, and Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease is a rare condition that can present with fever, night sweats, and lymphadenopathy.

elevated lactate dehydrogenase

candidates.protected_reason: Lymphoma is a heterogeneous group of diseases, and some subtypes may be underdiagnosed or misdiagnosed, particularly in patients with non-specific symptoms.
